n1.vlm_desc: A natural RGB photograph-style thumbnail of an urban street scene with buildings, road, cars and pedestrians; realistic lighting and colors; no overlays, no borders, no text.

n2.vlm_desc: A compact multi-label indicator icon: a small grid of rounded colored pills and tiny squares suggesting a multi-hot vector; abstract UI-like; no readable text, no letters or numbers.

n3.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle module with text 'Patch Embedding'. Include a small simple grid glyph (3x3) at left to suggest patches. Fill primary (#4A90D9) at low tint, dark text (#333), thin outline.

n4.pptx_intent: Small rounded rectangle or pill-shaped token element with text 'Loc Token'. Accent color (#fc8d62) fill, white or dark text; optionally a small vector-dot icon. Designed as an injected token.

n5.pptx_intent: Large rounded rectangle labeled 'SegFormer Backbone'. Add a simple stacked feature-pyramid glyph at right (3–4 offset rectangles). Primary theme styling, editable.

n6.pptx_intent: Small sidecar rounded rectangle labeled 'Adapter'. Place adjacent/attached to backbone stream. Primary tint fill, dark text, thin outline.

n7.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Classifier'. Add a tiny logits/bar glyph to the right (3–5 vertical bars). Editable shape and text.

n8.pptx_intent: Diamond (or hexagon) loss node labeled 'L_cls'. Add a small sigma/gradient-like glyph (simple ∑-style or arrows) as a tiny icon. Accent outline or accent corner mark.

n9.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Decoder'. Add a small upsampling icon (upward arrow over stepped blocks). Primary tint fill, dark text.

n10.vlm_desc: A segmentation result visualization: the same kind of street photo as input with a semi-transparent color-coded segmentation overlay (distinct solid regions in multiple colors for road, buildings, vehicles, sky). No legend, no text, no labels.

n11.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Patch Clustering'. Include a small icon showing dots grouped into 2–3 clusters (colored groups). Editable vector-like glyph.

n12.pptx_intent: Database cylinder shape labeled 'Memory Bank'. Add a few small vector glyphs inside (tiny circles/lines) to indicate stored embeddings. Primary tint fill, dark text.

n13.pptx_intent: Rounded rectangle labeled 'Pseudo Labeling'. Add a small refinement/wand icon and a tiny mask thumbnail icon at the edge. Editable shapes, accent highlight for the wand.

n14.vlm_desc: A standalone pseudo-label mask tile: semi-transparent colored segmentation regions with visible uncertainty—speckled/stippled texture and soft/noisy boundaries; no text, no legend, plain background.

n15.pptx_intent: Diamond (or hexagon) loss node labeled 'L_ce'. Add a tiny pixel-grid icon plus a small sigma/gradient glyph. Use accent color for outline or header strip.

n16.pptx_intent: Output icon representing trained weights: stacked layer rectangles with a small downward arrow and text 'Update'. Use neutral/primary tint, dark text. Editable group.
